title: Resolve Android icon-tap white-screen regression with single React Query provider and recoverable error UI

requirements.summary: Eliminate Android-only blank white-screen crash on icon taps by removing nested React Query providers and adding a recoverable in-app error boundary for navigation and icon interactions.
acceptanceCriteria: On Android, tapping each bottom navigation item (Dashboard, Calendar, Journal, Reports) switches pages without rendering a blank white screen.
On Android, tapping icon-based controls in the header (e.g., login/logout) does not crash the UI or render a blank white screen.

If a runtime error occurs during navigation or icon interaction, the user sees a recoverable in-app error state (not a blank white screen), and the app remains usable after recovery (e.g., returning to the previous screen or reloading the app shell).

No duplicate or nested React Query provider setup remains that could cause inconsistent context behavior during navigation (the app must use a single React Query provider instance for the whole React tree).

file_operations.description: Remove the nested QueryClientProvider (keep only the single app-wide provider created in frontend/src/main.tsx, which is immutable) and refactor App to render the existing AppContent under an app-level ErrorBoundary fallback so any runtime error does not result in a blank white screen.

Add a React error boundary component that catches render/lifecycle errors and shows a recoverable in-app error state with actions such as 'Reload app' (hard reload) and 'Go back' (history back) so the UI remains usable instead of a blank white screen.

Harden bottom navigation icon buttons for Android by ensuring each nav control is an explicit non-submitting button (type="button") and optionally guarding tab-change handlers against unexpected runtime errors so icon taps cannot blank-screen the app.

Harden header icon-based controls (login/logout and admin actions) by ensuring buttons are explicit non-submitting buttons (type="button") and wrapping async auth actions in robust try/catch so unexpected errors surface to the app-level recoverable error UI rather than causing a white screen.
